title: Safe diagnostic fallback on zero usable width (Racer, Switch)
description: One 5 Hz observation in which the ObservationBuilder hit zero usable road width and produced the safe diagnostic fallback (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Shared schema version 1': unknown schema, zero usable width or nonfinite input produces a safe diagnostic fallback). The sensor-derived features (ego 0-11, road-ahead 12-26, neighbor 27-50, history 51-56, occupancy 62-63) are replaced by the safe defaults (zeros here); masks.history_valid is 0 because no valid history is available. The explicit difficulty and style inputs are configuration, not sensors, so their one-hots stay correct (Racer at index 58, Switch at index 61) and the tick bookkeeping still satisfies traffic-age arithmetic (Racer 12). fallback.active is true with a reason and the substituted groups in defaults_applied. The exact safe-default vector content is an authored placeholder, not a specified value; see unknowns. No raw_inputs are supplied because normalization is bypassed in fallback. Status 'provisional'.

fallback.reason: zero usable road width at sampled_tick; sensor features replaced by safe diagnostic defaults

expectations.statement: Record difficulty, style and participant_id match the fixture context.
Even in fallback the explicit difficulty one-hot stays correct (Racer, index 58).
Even in fallback the explicit style one-hot stays correct (Switch, index 61).
The fallback zeroes all neighbor slots and clears masks.neighbor_slots.
The tick bookkeeping still satisfies traffic-age arithmetic (1200 - 1188 = 12).
Racer difficulty uses the 12-tick delayed traffic snapshot.
history_valid is 0 and every history feature is masked to zero.
fallback.active is true, so a non-empty reason and defaults_applied are required.
Every null that means 'not yet determined' has a matching unknowns entry.

comparison.purpose: Document the safe-fallback requirement a correct observation builder must satisfy, plus the standing parity target that includes invalid-input rejection.

metrics.name: actor_parity_max_abs_error
metrics.description: Python/GDScript actor-output parity over the observation corpus, including invalid-input rejection and fallback inputs.

unknowns.reason: The 'planned encounter' distance for corridor occupancy is not fixed by OPPONENT_AI.md.
Placeholder only: no ObservationBuilder revision is ratified until M4.2 implements the shared interface.
The exact safe diagnostic fallback vector (zeros for sensor features here) is an authored placeholder; OPPONENT_AI.md requires a safe diagnostic fallback but does not fix its contents.

history_valid is 0 with reset_generation 0 and post_reset_defaults_applied false: the safe diagnostic fallback masks history without a reset, and OPPONENT_AI.md never says whether a fallback must also bump reset_generation or set post_reset_defaults_applied. The validator accepts this state (one-way implication only) rather than inventing a stricter rule.
